next_escalation: If source acquisition is unavailable or evidence cannot be scored, create a lower-level governed acquisition/scoring/replay work order and keep r017 blocked.
no_fake_closure_policy: This artifact job is an executable research obligation. It does not mark the coverage gap PASS unless the concrete evidence artifact exists and the coverage register closes.
pass_predicate: falsifier trigger and negative controls are executable and not post-hoc
repair_strategy: Create the required artifact from governed open/free sources, bind hashes, then rerun the comparator gap and strict validator.
research_artifact_scope: falsifier and negative-control policy declared; not evidence of passed scoring

source_block.trigger: source-lock declaration contains observed target values, predictions, residuals, or row hashes; formula selection uses heldout target rows or non-prior validation rows; any comparator beats or ties the selected model within uncertainty/materiality policy; target mutation fails to change the candidate-pack or row hash; official source snapshot hash changes between acquisition and replay
